title: From a Kolhapur village to a boy band
text: Darshan Magdum, 22, from Dundage village, began posting songs on Instagram as a hobby; a 'random call' brought him into the American boy band Boy Throb. His teacher parents took time to understand content creation, and still encouraged him to pursue a master's degree and a stable job.
use: For 'Not all who wander are lost' (2023) and 'It is best to see life as a journey, not as a destination' (2025).

title: Technology denial that built a nation
text: Faced with restrictions on access to advanced technology, India's atomic energy programme built its own capabilities; scientific leadership, freedom for scientists, trust in young people and acceptance of failure made it possible.
use: For 'The Empires of the future will be the empires of the mind' (2024) and 'Best lessons are learnt through bitter experiences' (2025).

title: Jamsetji Tata's steel plant
text: When Jamsetji Tata applied to the imperial government in 1912 to set up a steel plant, a British official sneered that Indians simply could not do it. Permission was given and Tata succeeded. Today, writers ask whether he would have wanted the mix of duties and quality-control orders that now shield Indian steel.
use: For 'A ship in harbour is safe, but that is not what a ship is for' (2022) and 'Courage to accept and dedication to improve are two keys to success' (2019).
src: IE p. 9 (Montek S Ahluwalia et al.)

title: The players chose their coach
text: After two poor years, Hockey India asked the women's team what it wanted. The players asked for coach Sjoerd Marijne to return. He found a team without cohesion, rebuilt it on a vision 'not of just one', let players hold meetings without the coaches, and kept their Indian flair for dribbling while teaching when to use it. The team beat China for Asian Games gold. Goalkeeper Savita Punia, who had nearly quit two years earlier, said the coaches gave them freedom, and gold was their return gift.
use: For 'A good leader is one who follows the followers' (2026), 'Character of an institution is reflected in its leader' (2015) and 'Courage to accept and dedication to improve are two keys to success' (2019).
